name: Kim Do-young
bio: Kim Do-Young is an actress and director, known for Kim Ji-young: Born 1982 (2019), The Righteous Thief (2009) and The Naked Kitchen (2009). Her film Kim Ji-young: Born 1982 earned her Best New Director Awards at the 56th Baeksang Arts Awards and at the 25th Chunsa Arts Awards

credits.title: The Intern
credits.overview: Ki-ho, a retiree with 37 years of experience, joins fashion start-up WOO22 a senior intern, he struggles with its digital, unconventional culture. Despite their differences, Ki-ho and Sun-woo, the start-up's young CEO, learn from each other and form an unexpected bond.

credits.title: Once We Were Us
credits.overview: Seoul, 2008. On a bus heading to their hometown, fate brings Eun-ho and Jeong-won together, sparking an unlikely friendship. credits.title: Camel in the tent
credits.overview: Seon-yeong is surprised when Yura, a friend from her hometown, suddenly visits her. Seon-yeong has no choice but to let Yura stay at her place for a few nights since she has no plans. But Yura does not leave, and Seon-yeong gets irritated by her overstays.

credits.overview: Chang-sik, a retired man, lives with his wife, Gilsoon and her caretaker, Soo-ok, an illegal immigrant. One day, a bedsore develops on Gilsoon, which does not seem to heal. credits.title: Kim Ji-young: Born 1982
credits.overview: Kim Ji-young, an ordinary woman in her 30s, suddenly shows signs of being inhabited by other women from her life, past and present.

credits.title: Last Child
credits.overview: Six months ago the son of the married couple drowned. The couple, together with the teenager that their son saved, begin a journey to cope with the loss.

credits.title: The Monologue
credits.overview: An actress who lives a busy life with her baby receives a call for an audition from a famous director’s production team.

credits.title: Camellias in Bloom
credits.overview: Yeonhwa lives as an ordinary person. One day, she hears her aunt's death and goes to her funeral with her father. Her father criticizes her aunt's life and Yeonhwa finds a video from the aunt's keepsake.

credits.title: Fourth Place
credits.overview: A former Asian Games record breaker and Olympic tryout, Kim Gwang-su, endures beatings, abuse, and constant ridicule from his swimming coach. To justify this abusive behavior, his coach constantly reminded Gwang-su - this is for your own good.

credits.title: The Treacherous
credits.overview: The story of Joseon's tyrant king Yeonsan who exploits the populace for his own carnal pleasures, his seemingly loyal retainer who controls him and all court dealings, and a woman who seeks vengeance.

credits.title: Kimchi
credits.overview: Jin-Yeong gets Kimchi by courier from her mother. Her older sister Jin-sook who lives with her mother gives Jin-Yeong a complexion with kimchi. credits.title: Killer Toon
credits.overview: A web-comic artist finds that a series of murders are occurring that have a disturbing resemblance to the images in her work.

credits.title: Return of the Mafia
credits.overview: Three former mafia members work at a construction company to avoid getting involved in the underworld again. But fates draw them back to the past when a gangster approaches one of them.

credits.title: All About My Wife
credits.overview: A man asks a womanizer to seduce his wife in order to catalyze a divorce.

credits.title: Helpless
credits.overview: A woman suddenly disappears. Her fiance then sets out to find her and, in the process, uncovers layers of dark hidden secrets.

credits.title: Loveholic
credits.overview: Film examines the matters of labor and love. After losing her job, a single professional woman moves into her friend's flat -- where she develops an attraction to her friend's husband. Meanwhile, the friend finds herself falling for one of her husband's colleagues.

credits.title: The Day After
credits.overview: A divorcee reevaluates her life after a chance meeting with another woman with a similar history.

credits.title: Marathon
credits.overview: Cho-won is an autistic but happy young man who loves to draw zebras and run. His mother wants him to feel normal by accomplishing a feat that no one thought his son could achieve. With the help of a coach in exile, she trains him to become a marathon runner.

credits.title: Oasis
credits.overview: A young man released from prison visits the widow of the man he killed drunk-driving and becomes infatuated with his cerebral palsy-stricken daughter.
